node.title: Perl 28 broke L: How to fix?
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Dear Monks,

Having an issue with one of the best modules: [cpan://L]. Before Perl 5.28 it warns about "Use of inherited AUTOLOAD for non-method" when calling subs but in 5.28 it's "no longer allowed". Is there a way to fix L? Or another module with the same feature? perl -ML -e 'Data::Dump::dd(HTTP::Tiny->new->get("https://www.perlmonks.org")->{headers})'
